integrity: All numerical tests are finite corroborations; the complete stability and covariance statements are proved analytically. Priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the explicitly defined two-mode critically scaled Itô Euler sampler and finite second moments only; it does not address higher moments, invariant-law Gaussianity, other discretizations, or non-Gaussian targets. Equivalent formulations in the broader noncommuting linear-SDE literature remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp Euler stability and anisotropic covariance inflation for a reversible Stratonovich Langevin sampler
